actions.action: Cut away rotted roots if present
Let cut roots dry a few hours, then repot in fresh well-draining mix in a pot with drainage hole
Water thoroughly only when soil is dry several cm down (about every 3-4 weeks in winter)
Move plants away from cold windows, drafts and heaters to 15-20°C bright indirect light
Group plants or set up pebble tray for humidity
Take segment cuttings, callus them and root in cactus mix if badly damaged
Let oxalis dry out more, check it for rot, and keep it from drafts

reason: The answer diagnoses root rot from overwatering instead of underwatering. It advises drying out further, watering every 3-4 weeks and repotting, which would worsen the thirsty plants and delay the needed watering.
